_comment: Which source font renders which .ffu. Sizes are auto-fitted to each template's uppercase height. cell = glyph cell height, forced to the template's: the engine scales a glyph by 88/cell, so letting the cell grow to fit Vietnamese tone marks shrinks all text - the 108-cell build rendered 19% smaller than the stock game. Paths are relative to the repo root.

window/font/sysfont.ffu.note: menus and key prompts; spacing as the typeface designs it

window/font/advfont1.ffu.note: in-game font option I; Newsreader 36pt Medium

window/font/advfont2.ffu.note: in-game font option II; Lora Regular, do dam nguyen ban

window/font/advfont3.ffu.note: in-game font option III; stroke ratio 1.20

window/font/advfont4.ffu.note: in-game font option IV; stroke ratio 1.17
